speaker: charlie
text: And to finish us off today, something truly awe inspiring, out in the channel country the outback has burst into colour after that good winter rain. We are talking carpets of gold and purple wildflowers stretching to the horizon.

speaker: alice
text: Honestly, photos of it look like something out of a painting, it is one of nature's best kept secrets out west. If you ever get the chance to see it in person, do it, it does not happen every year.

speaker: charlie
text: A reminder that even after a tough dry stretch, this state has a knack for bouncing back with a bit of colour and life. That is the Bright Side spirit right there.

speaker: alice
text: It really is. Thanks for spending your Friday with us, we will be back tomorrow with more good news from around Queensland.

speaker: charlie
text: Look after each other out there, get outside and enjoy that sunshine. See ya tomorrow, Queensland.
